title: Major banks running stablecoin, crypto-trading pilots with Coinbase, Armstrong says
summary: At the DealBook Summit, BlackRock CEO Larry Fink acknowledged Bitcoin’s utility, as Coinbase’s Brian Armstrong said the exchange is running pilots with major US banks.

title: XRP faces ‘now or never’ moment as traders eye rally to $2.50
summary: XRP shows renewed strength as traders crunch the charts to see if a rally into the $2.30 to $2.50 zone is possible. Does the bulk of the move depend on Bitcoin’s short-term performance?

title: Bitcoin’s strongest trading day since May cues possible rally to $107K
summary: Bitcoin posted its strongest daily gain since May as buy-side flows, a sharp adjustment in investor sentiment and a return of the Coinbase premium hint at a potential rally above $100,000.

title: Polymarket opens US app to waitlisted users after CFTC green light
summary: Select users in the US will be among the first to access the predictions platform to bet on sports event contracts, following clearance from a financial regulator for a relaunch.

title: SEC sends warning letters to ETF issuers targeting untamed leverage
summary: The United States Securities and Exchange Commission halted several ETF filings that proposed 3-5 times leverage on the underlying asset.

title: ETHZilla takes stake in Karus to tokenize AI-modeled auto-loan portfolios
summary: The deal grants ETHZilla access to Karus’s AI underwriting engine and loan origination network, positioning the crypto treasury company to offer auto credit onchain in 2026.

title: Taiwan eyes 2026 stablecoin launch as crypto legislation advances: Report
summary: A Taiwan-issued stablecoin pegged to either the country’s dollar or the US dollar could enter the market in the second half of 2026 based on related legislation.

title: Miners are turning off their machines: Why even new rigs can’t break even
summary: Miner margins are collapsing as hash price hits record lows. This guide explains 2025 economics, break-even tests and what struggling operators can do.

title: Why Tether is buying more gold than many central banks and what it signals
summary: Tether’s rapid gold accumulation in Q3 2025 surpassed many national banks. This move reflects Tether’s strategy to build gold reserves.

title: CleanSpark lifts output and power as Bitcoin miners face strain
summary: November production rose 11% and contracted power topped 1.4 GW, even as falling bitcoin prices and tighter margins pressure the mining sector.
